entity.name: Rahul Dass
entity.description: Founder and sole maintainer of QWED, an open-source verification layer for LLM and AI-agent output.

projects.name: QWED Protocol (Core)
projects.description: Open-source verification layer for LLM and AI-agent output. Checks AI-generated math, logic, SQL, code and schemas with deterministic engines (SymPy, Z3, SQLGlot, AST analysis) and fails closed when a result cannot be verified.

projects.name: QWED Tax
projects.description: Deterministic verification for AI-generated tax decisions, using Z3 and decimal arithmetic. Sits between AI agents and execution systems; not a calculator or filing platform.

projects.name: QWED Legal
projects.description: Deterministic verification of computational legal claims: dates, amounts and structured constraints. Blocks unproven legal outputs.

projects.name: QWED Finance
projects.description: Deterministic verification for AI-generated financial decisions: NPV, IRR, Black-Scholes, YTM and VaR, AML/KYC rules with Z3, and ISO 20022 / SWIFT schemas. Fails closed.

projects.name: QWED UCP
projects.description: Deterministic verification for Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) checkouts: catches math, state and schema errors before payment.

plans.name: QWED Infrastructure Sustainability Grant
plans.description: QWED is currently maintained by a single maintainer. Funding supports long-term sustainability of this deterministic AI verification infrastructure, including security hardening, threat modeling, CI/CD enforcement, SBOM generation, supply-chain protection, documentation improvements, and ecosystem integrations. External funding directly increases reliability and reduces downstream risk for organizations relying on QWED in high-stakes AI deployments.

plans.name: Extended Security & Audit Support
plans.description: Supports extended runway for infrastructure stability, third-party security reviews, container hardening, deterministic engine validation, maintaining OpenSSF Best Practices Gold, SBOM attestation, and contributor onboarding. Enables structured security audits and long-term ecosystem growth.
